task_definition.task_description: Please check whether NASDAQ is currently open, then get the current BTC price. After that, verify the status of my checking account for user_001, prepare a medium-priority in-app trip summary balance report in USD for that account, then place a $300 buy order for AAPL, and finally send the checking account balance summary to user_001 through the app.
